animals.name: Rattlesnake
animals.sightLog: A dry rattle from the shade under a rock. A rattlesnake, coiled, deciding about you.
animals.backAwayLog: You step back slowly, then again. The rattle fades. Nothing gained, nothing lost.
animals.backAwayStrikeLog: You step back and the snake decides anyway. A punch in the calf.
animals.killLog: You pin it and finish it. Then you keep well clear of the head, which is still opening and closing.
animals.failLog: You go for it and it is faster. A punch in the forearm.
animals.escapeLog: You swing and miss. The snake pours itself into a crack and is gone.

journal.name: Rattlesnake
journal.text: A rattlesnake is food if you cook it. Its head can still bite after it is dead.

drops.log: You strip the sinew from its back and set it to dry. It will bind better than anything in the wreck.

animals.ambushLog: A buzz, then a punch in the calf. The snake is still there, coiled at the edge of the shade. Now you can see exactly where it is.
animals.letGoLog: You back off and let it have the shade. The bite comes with you.

animals.name: Bark scorpion
animals.sightLog: A pale scorpion on the rock by your hand, tail up, very still.
animals.backAwayLog: You take your hand back and give it the rock.
animals.backAwayStrikeLog: You pull back a fraction too slowly. The sting is a hot nail.
animals.killLog: You crush it and pinch the stinger off. It is a mouthful, but it is a mouthful.
animals.failLog: You miss, and it does not. The sting is a hot nail in the wrist.
animals.escapeLog: It skitters under the rock before you connect.

journal.name: Scorpion
journal.text: Scorpions are edible cooked once the stinger is off.

animals.ambushLog: You move a stone and the stone disagrees. The sting is a hot nail in the wrist. The scorpion is still on the rock, tail up, in plain sight.
animals.letGoLog: You leave it the rock and nurse the wrist.

raw.log: You chew it raw. Stringy, cold, and it is food.
raw.sickLog: An hour later your gut turns over. Raw snake was a bad bet.

journal.name: Raw snake meat
journal.text: Raw snake meat can make you sick. Cook it on the fire pit.

cook.log: Over the fire pit the meat whitens and drips. It tastes like a decision that worked.

raw.log: You crunch it raw. It is mostly shell.
raw.sickLog: Your stomach does not agree with the shell or the venom sac.

cook.log: Roasted on a stone, the scorpion is crisp and faintly like shrimp.

spoilLog: The {name} has turned in the heat. You leave it for the ants.

ambush.note: Awake encounters from the hazard roll open a sighting. This share are ambushes: it strikes first, then you can still try to kill it.
